name: option-test-1b0c555df9/integer_option_invalid_value-p.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: Function definition — Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature
reason: The record and included-record parameter signature are supported, but the assertion requires the executable launcher to parse --val=name as an integer command-line option and panic on its invalid value. Command-line option binding and its failure behavior are not covered by subset10's positive feature list; signature support alone does not establish that behavior.
unsupported_constructs: Command-line option binding to an included-record main parameter and rejection of an invalid integer option value
test_design_notes: The @args and @panic comments assert launcher behavior before the empty main body executes.
